name: mcp-triage
description: Too many MCP servers cluttering your session? For the task you're about to do, /mcp-triage recommends the minimal set of MCP servers to keep and prints the exact commands to disable the rest — plus the restore commands, captured first so nothing is lost. It's read-only: it advises, you run the commands. And it's honest about the payoff — Claude Code already defers MCP tool schemas, so the real win is a faster, quieter startup and less tool-selection noise, not big token savings. Free, offline, stdlib-only, no API keys.
